children: Affirm Holdings CEO Max Levchin told Bloomberg Businessweek Daily that the company’s customers are “healthy, paying us back on time, and shopping,” according to Bloomberg.
He also discussed Affirm’s recent earnings report, including an upbeat revenue outlook, its most profitable quarter on record, recent partnerships and e-commerce growth.

title: Affirm CEO Says Consumers Are Healthy as Revenue Outlook Improves
